summary: Edaravone (RADICAVA, RADICAVA ORS) is FDA-approved for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It is available as a 60 mg intravenous infusion given over 60 minutes and as a 105 mg (5 mL) oral suspension taken in the morning after overnight fasting. It is given in treatment cycles: an initial cycle of daily dosing for 14 days followed by 14 drug-free days, then subsequent cycles of daily dosing for 10 of every 14 days followed by 14 drug-free days. Both formulations contain sodium bisulfite and may cause hypersensitivity, anaphylaxis, and sulfite-related reactions (including asthmatic episodes) in susceptible patients.

dosage.d: 60 mg (as two consecutive 30 mg bags) over 60 minutes total (~1 mg/min)
dosage.t: Daily for 14 days, then a 14-day drug-free period
dosage.n: Discontinue promptly at first signs of a hypersensitivity reaction

dosage.t: Daily for 10 days out of each 14-day period, then a 14-day drug-free period
dosage.n: Do not inject other medications into the bag or mix with RADICAVA

dosage.d: 105 mg (5 mL) in the morning after overnight fasting
dosage.t: Daily for 14 days, then a 14-day drug-free period
dosage.n: No food for 1 hour after dosing (water permitted); use the supplied 5 mL oral syringe

dosage.t: Daily for 10 days out of each 14-day period, then a 14-day drug-free period
dosage.n: Patients on 60 mg IV may switch to 105 mg ORS at the same dosing frequency

admin: RADICAVA injection: give each 60 mg dose as two consecutive 30 mg IV bags over 60 minutes total; do not use if the oxygen indicator has turned blue/purple; use within 24 hours of opening the overwrap
RADICAVA ORS: invert and shake vigorously at least 30 seconds before opening; take in the morning on an empty stomach after overnight fasting, no food for 1 hour after (water OK)
Fast before ORS dosing per food type: 8 h after a high-fat meal, 4 h after a low-fat meal, 2 h after a caloric supplement
ORS may be given via NG/PEG tube (silicone, PVC, or polyurethane); flush with at least 30 mL water before and after
Discard ORS not used within 15 days of opening or within 30 days from shipment date, whichever is first; measure only with the supplied oral syringe
moa: The mechanism by which edaravone exerts its therapeutic effect in patients with ALS is unknown. Edaravone is a free-radical scavenger thought to reduce oxidative stress, a proposed contributor to motor neuron injury in ALS.

absolute: History of hypersensitivity to edaravone or any inactive ingredient (hypersensitivity and anaphylactic reactions have occurred)
relative: Sulfite sensitivity (contains sodium bisulfite); use caution, particularly in asthmatic patients
monitor: Signs and symptoms of hypersensitivity/anaphylaxis during and after administration

preg: Based on animal data, edaravone may cause fetal harm. There are no adequate human data; in animal studies edaravone produced adverse developmental effects (increased mortality, decreased growth, delayed sexual development, altered behavior) at clinically relevant doses, often with maternal toxicity. Advise patients to notify their provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy.
lact: There are no data on the presence of edaravone in human milk, effects on the breastfed infant, or effects on milk production. Edaravone and its metabolites are excreted in the milk of lactating rats. Consider the developmental and health benefits of breastfeeding alongside the mother's clinical need and any potential adverse effects on the infant.
renal: No dosage adjustment is necessary in mild to moderate renal impairment; exposure changes were not clinically significant. The effects of severe renal impairment have not been studied.
hepatic: No dosage adjustment is necessary in hepatic impairment (mild, moderate, or severe); exposure changes were not clinically significant.

interactions.food: RADICAVA ORS must be taken in the morning after overnight fasting with no food for 1 hour after dosing (water permitted); a high-fat meal markedly reduces exposure (Cmax decreased 82%, AUC 61% versus fasted).
interactions.alcohol: No specific interaction with alcohol noted in labeling.
interactions.diagnostics: Edaravone pharmacokinetics are not expected to be significantly affected by CYP, UGT, or transporter inhibitors, and edaravone is not expected to significantly inhibit or induce major CYP enzymes or transporters.

monitoring: Signs and symptoms of hypersensitivity reactions during and after infusion/administration
Sulfite-related reactions, especially in asthmatic patients
counsel: Seek immediate medical care for signs of a hypersensitivity reaction (hives, swelling, low blood pressure, difficulty breathing)
The product contains a sulfite (sodium bisulfite) that can cause allergic or asthmatic reactions in susceptible people; seek care if these occur
For the oral suspension, take it in the morning on an empty stomach after overnight fasting and do not eat for 1 hour after (water is OK)
Notify your provider if you become pregnant or plan to, or if you are breastfeeding
If using a feeding tube, flush with about 30 mL of water before and after each dose
pk: Cmax of IV edaravone is reached by the end of the 60-minute infusion
Oral (ORS): median Tmax ~0.5 hour (range 0.25-0.75 h) fasted; oral bioavailability ~57%
No plasma accumulation with once-daily dosing; given in 14-day cycles
RADICAVA: store up to 25 C, protect from light, use within 24 h of opening overwrap. RADICAVA ORS: pharmacy refrigerate 2-8 C; patient store upright at 20-25 C, protect from light, do not freeze
pearls: FDA-approved for ALS; available as both 60 mg IV infusion and 105 mg (5 mL) oral suspension
Cycle dosing: initial 14 days on / 14 days off, then 10 of every 14 days on / 14 days off
Contains sodium bisulfite; watch for sulfite-related reactions, especially in asthmatics
ORS is bioequivalent in AUC to IV under fasted conditions; food (especially high-fat) substantially lowers absorption
No dosage adjustment needed for hepatic impairment or mild-moderate renal impairment
missed: Maintain the prescribed cycle schedule. For RADICAVA ORS, take the dose in the morning after overnight fasting; if a scheduled dose in a treatment cycle is missed, do not double up. Discuss missed doses with the prescriber, since dosing follows defined 14-day treatment cycles.
overdose: No specific overdose information or antidote is provided in the labeling. In the event of overdose, provide supportive care and monitor for hypersensitivity and sulfite-related reactions.
